captions.detailed: A Newtonian reflector telescope mounted on a dark grey equatorial mount and a three-legged tripod. The telescope tube is light grey with black structural rings, a black finder scope, and a black open aperture showing internal structural ribs. The equatorial mount is highly detailed, featuring a polar axis, a declination axis, counterweights, and adjustable adjustment knobs. The tripod consists of three thin, angled legs connected by a central triangular spreader tray.
captions.instruction: Generate a Newtonian reflector telescope on an equatorial mount and tripod. The telescope should feature a light grey cylindrical main tube with black structural rings and a finder scope. The mount must include a detailed polar axis assembly, counterweights, and a declination axis, all supported by a three-legged tripod with a central spreader tray.
captions.factory: Construct the telescope using an ArticulatedObject builder. Create the tripod base by combining three angled cylindrical legs with a central circular spreader plate. Build the equatorial mount using a sequence of cylinders and boxes representing the polar axis block, declination axis housing, counterweight shaft, and cylindrical counterweights. Model the main optical tube as a hollow cylinder with a dark interior, wrapped in thin black rings (constructed using slightly larger hollow cylinders), and attach a smaller finder scope cylinder using offset box brackets.
